Create Patient.description: Creates a Patient using the patient builder.

Create Observation.description: Creates an Observation, e.g. a malaria rapid test result.

Create Encounter.description: Creates an outpatient Encounter for a patient.

Update Patient.description: Replaces (or creates) a Patient at a known id.

Upload Transaction Bundle.description: Collects resources into a transaction Bundle and posts it in one request.

Delete Resource.description: Deletes a single FHIR resource by reference.
Delete Resource.code:
// Delete an Observation entered in error.
delete(`Observation/${$.data.observationId}`);

Read Patient.description: Fetches a single Patient by id.

Search Patients By Identifier.description: Finds Patients matching an identifier, e.g. a national ID.

Search Recently Updated Observations.description: Fetches Observations for a patient changed since a cursor.

Search Encounters By Date.description: Finds Encounters at a facility within a date range.
